title: fix(core): refuse an empty operator map beside a key that lowers (objectui#10788)
body:
Fixes #10788
Clause-②: no — the converter starts refusing a shape objectstack#5240 ruled REJECTED (recorded on FilterConditionSchema's docblock); no declared surface moves

## Round 2 — the contract review's text fixes

Round 1's contract review (`5857887938`) FAILed on four published sentences; the code, pins, semver and merge state passed. Round 2 (`1407f7bae8`) is text only. The changed `.ts` lines are all comment lines, and every touched changeset's frontmatter md5 is unchanged (`291f1f84b46b1aac462254c4f05035b3`):
1. `packages/data-objectstack/README.md`: "is refused too, alone or beside other keys, with a" (was "wherever it appears").
2. `convertFiltersToAST`'s exported JSDoc drops "anywhere in the filter".
3. `.changeset/8555-…`: its objectui#10788 dated note attributes each quoted sentence to its own entry (this change's reading, and the objectui#9164 note's reading).
4. `.changeset/8567-…`: the same split, in its dated note only.
5. `.changeset/identity-fold-skipped-keys-9030.md`: a dated note (the object tail now serves `{}` only).
6. The `filter-exotic-comparand-8567.test.ts` header gains an `UPDATED (objectui#10788)` line. Comment only.
7. `.changeset/9164-…`: "sentences about that boundary".
8. `refuseEmptyOperatorMap`'s doc comment: a `$and` / `$or` member is refused once `lowerLogicalGroup` converts it (a TRUE disjunct earlier in an `$or` still returns first; objectui#10789). Comment only.

Gates on `1407f7bae8`: `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check:new-line-citations` exit 0. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against `origin/main` `a14fb23b3b` is clean.


## What changed

- `convertFiltersToAST` (`packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts`) refuses an empty operator map in its operator-map arm, where it is met: `if (operatorEntries.length === 0) refuseEmptyOperatorMap(field);`. objectui#9164 refused it in the general tail, which is entered only when no condition was produced; beside a key that lowers, the tail was never reached and the key vanished. The tail's `emptyOperatorMapField` recording and its guard are deleted. The arm now answers the alone case (objectui#9164) and the beside case (this card) through ONE throw site, so there is no second refusal to double-throw or to drift.
- `refuseEmptyOperatorMap` keeps its class (`FilterOperatorError`), its envelope (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400, `field` set, no `operator`) and its wording shape. The clause "and nothing else in the filter produced a condition" is gone, because it is false for the beside case, and the history sentence now names both old behaviours. The docblocks of `refuseEmptyOperatorMap` and `isOperatorMap`, the two tail comments, and the `@throws` / `@example` of `convertFiltersToAST` are brought in line.
- Grade: `'@object-ui/core': patch`, the grade PR objectui#10784 gave its sibling refusal: the refused input is spec-REJECTED and never worked, and no export, type or signature moves. Not `major`.
- Tests: new `filter-empty-operator-map-beside-key-10788.test.ts` (core) and `filter-empty-operator-map-beside-key-two-routes-10788.test.ts` (data-objectstack). The objectui#8555 and objectui#8567 boundary rows are flipped on purpose, each with a note citing objectui#10788 and objectstack#5240.
- Changesets: `.changeset/10788-empty-operator-map-beside-key-refused.md`. Dated notes in the objectui#10533 form are appended to the pending 8555, 8567 and 9164 entries, each of which says an empty map beside a key that lowers still constrains nothing. Frontmatter is byte-identical: the md5 of the frontmatter block is `291f1f84b46b1aac462254c4f05035b3` before and after, on all three.
- File-surface additions beyond the claim, declared here:
  - the 9164 test file's header gains one UPDATED paragraph. Its sentence "an empty operator map BESIDE a key that lowers is still dropped" became false;
  - the dated note on the pending 9164 changeset (same reason);
  - one sentence in `packages/data-objectstack/README.md`: "An empty operator object `{}` is untouched — it constrains nothing, as it always has". It was false for the alone case since objectui#9164 and is now false entirely. A README is `*.md`, so no data-objectstack changeset is owed.

## H1 — reproduced on `main`

Base `6cf599985d`. Driven through `convertFiltersToAST` and through `ObjectStackAdapter.find` with a mocked `fetch`, which is the adapter's HTTP boundary per objectui#9164. `$expand` is the route discriminator. The probe is throwaway and not committed.

| input | `convertFiltersToAST` | plain route | `$expand` route |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `{ status: 'a', created: {} }` | `["status","=","a"]` | `?filter=["status","=","a"]` | `?populate=owner&filter=["status","=","a"]` |
| CONTROL `{ status: 'a' }` | `["status","=","a"]` | `?filter=["status","=","a"]` | `?populate=owner&filter=["status","=","a"]` |
| `{ created: {} }` (objectui#9164) | throws `FilterOperatorError`, `INVALID_FILTER` 400, field `created` | rejected, 0 data requests | rejected, 0 data requests |

On head `5cc126bfd0`, the first row reads: the converter throws `FilterOperatorError` (`INVALID_FILTER` 400, field `created`), and both routes reject with 0 data requests. The control row is byte-unchanged.

## H2 — census: who emits an empty operator map BESIDE another key

A throwaway probe (not committed) drove the real producers, 4189 calls in all. It counts, in every object of the output tree, a non-`$` key whose value is an empty plain object while the same object has another key. Positive controls lit in the same run: the scanner reports 1 for `{ status: 'a', created: {} }` and 0 for `{ status: 'a' }`, and `lookupFiltersToRecord` with an authored `eq` value `{}` reports 1.

| producer | how rows combine | calls | hits on live values | evidence |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `FilterConditionField` `condToMongo` + `filterGroupToMongo` (merge rule copied verbatim; JSON round-trip, as storage does) | AND with no key collision goes through `Object.assign` into ONE object, so this is the only builder that can produce the same-object spelling | 3680 | 0 | 70 hits, all with value `undefined`: `$ne` / `$gt` / `$lt` / `$gte` / `$lte` / after / before, over 10 field types. `{ created: { $ne: undefined } }` is stored as `{"created":{}}` and merged beside `status`. The builder never holds `undefined`: `addCondition` seeds `""`, `reshapeFilterValue` and the field-switch retype answer `""`, `LookupValuePicker` clears to `""` or `[]`, and every value editor writes a string, a list or a boolean. Dormant; the same producer objectui#9164 named. |
| dataset filter inspector `groupToCondition` | one object per row, `$and` for several | 368 | 0 | single-key by construction; `isFilterValueComplete` drops `undefined` |
| dashboard `buildWidgetScopedFilter` / `buildFilterCondition` | one object per filter, `$and`; merged with the widget's own filter by `mergeFilters`, also `$and` | 66 | 0 | runtime only, never stored |
| `RecordPickerDialog` `lookupFiltersToRecord` | ONE object | 63 | 0 | only an AUTHORED `eq` value `{}` hits (the control above) |
| drill: `computeDrillFilter` defaults, `buildDatasetDrillFilter` | one object | 12 | 0 | scalars, `null`, `{ $null: true }`, and `{ $gte, $lt }`, which has two keys at runtime |
| view filters (`ListViewSchema.filter`, `ViewTab.filter`), URL filter params, ListView filter panel, user and quick filters | spec `ViewFilterRule[]` or `FilterGroup`, lowered to AST triples | read | 0 | never the `$` dialect |
| placeholder resolvers (`resolveContextTokens`, `resolveFilterPlaceholders`) | walk | read | 0 | keep every key |
| authored metadata (`table.defaultFilters`, page `config.filter`, drill `config.filter`, lookup filters) | — | — | only if written | the case this refusal is for |

No live producer emits the same-object spelling, so the stop valve did not fire.

## H3 — the arm

- **Where it dropped.** In `convertFiltersToAST`'s operator-map arm. `Object.entries({})` is `[]`, so the operator loop ran zero times and pushed nothing. The arm recorded `emptyOperatorMapField`, but only the `conditions.length === 0` tail read it. With `status` lowered, `conditions.length === 1` returned `conditions[0]`, and the recorded field was never consulted.
- **objectui#9164's refusal.** `refuseEmptyOperatorMap(field)` throws `FilterOperatorError`: `code` `INVALID_FILTER`, `httpStatus` 400, `field` set, `operator` undefined. Its message began "[ObjectUI] The filter on field 'FIELD' is an EMPTY operator map — { FIELD: {} } names the field and no operator, and nothing else in the filter produced a condition." This PR keeps the class, the envelope and the shape, and drops the clause that is false for the beside case.
- **The bare top-level `{ created: {} }`** was already refused on base (H1, row 3). The beside case is covered without double-throwing because there is no second guard: the arm refuses the moment it meets the map, the tail guard is deleted, and `refuseEmptyOperatorMap` stays the one throw site for this shape. The objectui#9050 throw-site enumeration count is unchanged and green on head. The new pin's §3 compares the alone and beside errors with each other (same `message`, same `name`) instead of pinning wording.
- **Order effect, stated.** The map is now judged in iteration order, like the two comparand arms. In a filter holding BOTH an empty map and another refusable key, the first one met names the refusal; before, the empty map lost to every loop refusal. No test pins such a mixture.

## Pins and ablation

Refusal rows assert the envelope (`FilterOperatorError`, `code`, `httpStatus`, `field`, no `operator`, `filterRefusalSubject`), never `toThrow()` alone. Messages are not pinned; §3 compares two errors with each other.

- **Red on base.** The base converter (blob `084c1d1a1c`) was swapped in, its hash verified equal to the base blob, and 6 files run: `Tests  14 failed | 61 passed (75)`. Red: the 10 core refusal rows (the card's input, 5 neighbours, 2 combinator members, the safe entry, the one-refusal row), the 2 route rows, and the flipped 8555 and 8567 rows. Green on base: every control (`{ status: 'a' }` on the converter and on both routes, a real operator beside the key, a skipped `null` beside the key, `{}`) and the 9164 and 9050 files. Trap restore: `RESTORED hash=6973b1ce90b6… == HEAD blob; git diff HEAD empty`.
- **Green on head** `5cc126bfd0`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/core/ packages/data-objectstack/ scripts/__tests__/dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts` gave `Test Files  248 passed (248)`, `Tests  4538 passed (4538)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Ablation** through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of `if (operatorEntries.length === 0) refuseEmptyOperatorMap(field);`. Proof it landed: `anchor x1 -> x0`, `blob 6973b1ce90b6 -> 75361bad47e2`. 11 files gave `Tests  29 failed | 171 passed (200)`.
  - Red: the same 14 beside-key rows, plus 15 rows that pin the ALONE refusal: 9164 x6, 8770 x2, core 9020 x2, 9030 x2, 9001 x1, data-objectstack 9020 x1, and the 9050 subject row.
  - Every red row asserts a refusal, and no control went red. The 9050 throw-site count stays green because the throw site remains.
  - The alone rows go red too because the one guard now serves both cases, by design (H3).
  - Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (6973b1ce90b6) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
  - No `dist` step: `vitest.config.mts` aliases `@object-ui/core` to `packages/core/src`, and the route rows reddening under the ablation shows the data-objectstack suite resolves the same source.

## Gates (HEAD `5cc126bfd0`)

- The dependency closure was built first: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/data-objectstack^...' build` (types, core; `✓ dist completeness`), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): `CORE_TYPECHECK_EXIT=0`. `--listFiles` on the test program holds all 4 edited or new core test files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack type-check`, whose `include` is `src/**/*` so the route test is in the program: `DOS_TYPECHECK_EXIT=0`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `✅  6 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: `✅  No changeset declares a major bump`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` is report-only. It lists the 3 dated-note edits, and each one's `declared at base` equals its `declares now` (`@object-ui/core: patch`).
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` is report-only. One pending body names a touched file: `8568-retire-dollar-dialect-lowercase-aliases.md`, on `packages/data-objectstack/README.md`'s operator tables. Read, and still true: the tables are untouched.
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` ✅, `pnpm check:control-bytes` ✅ (`OK (scanned 8994 tracked text file(s)`), `pnpm check:test-path-roots` ✅, `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- Lint, narrowed to the 6 touched `.ts` files with `pnpm exec eslint --format json`:
  - Result: `files_linted=6 errors=0 warnings=8`. All 8 are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in `filter-converter.ts`; the diff adds zero `any` type tokens.
  - Population: eslint's own JSON reports 6 results and no ignored-file notice.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:readme-exports`, reason: prerequisite not met. It needs every package's `dist` types and printed "511 self-import(s) could not be judged … not on disk"; a whole-repo build belongs to CI. The README edit is one prose sentence with no fenced block and no import.
- NOT MEASURED: the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test`. Both belong to CI.

## Serial

- `git fetch origin main` into a private ref, then `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` against `f812f37897`: exit 0, tree `c2c4a45718`. Six commits landed on `main` after the base `6cf599985d`, and none touches a file in this diff.
- Open PRs re-read: 9 open. The 8 non-release PRs were read through the REST files endpoint, and none touches `filter-converter.ts`, the 8555 / 8567 / 9164 test files, `packages/data-objectstack/README.md` or the three noted changesets.
- The release PR objectui#5400 was read through its branch in git: it carries none of the three noted changesets. If it merged first, the three dated-note edits would conflict (modify/delete), and "Later in this same release" would be false. Land this before the next release cut.

## Acceptance notes

- **What objectui#10789 inherits.** It edits `lowerLogicalGroup` next, and this PR stays out of that function per the dispatch fence.
  - The child comment in `lowerLogicalGroup` still says an empty-operator-map child "never gets here: the same tail refuses it". Since this PR the refusal is the operator-map arm's, not the tail's; "never gets here" stays true. Reword it when touching the function.
  - `{ $or: [{}, { a: {} }] }` and `{ $or: [{}, { status: 'a', created: {} }] }` still answer TRUE (`undefined`), not a refusal, because `lowerLogicalGroup` returns on the first TRUE disjunct before it converts later members. Unchanged here; order-dependent, and pre-existing for every refusal arm.
  - Render-time readers (PeoplePicker `recentFilter`, RecordPickerDialog `mergedFilter`, `composeElementDataSource`, `composeDrillFilter`, `useElementDataSourceSchema`) throw converter refusals from render or from a click. This refusal now joins them for the beside case too. Reaching it needs authored metadata (H2).
- **The 9050 enumeration row's label** reads "empty operator map with no other condition". Its input `{ a: {} }` is still exactly that, so the row is true; the arm it enumerates is now wider.
- **The 9030 changeset (round 2).** `identity-fold-skipped-keys-9030.md` said the object tail "still serves … an empty operator map `{ a: {} }`"; objectui#9164 made that false and did not note it. Round 2 appends a dated note in the objectui#10533 form (frontmatter byte-identical), on the contract review's recommendation.
- **Another face answers the same shape differently.** `ValueDataSource`'s object `$filter` matcher (not this converter) selects rows `1,2` for `{ status: 'a', created: {} }`, the same rows as `{ status: 'a' }`, and every row for `{ created: {} }`. Measured with the H1 probe on head, three rows. It is reported to the seat as a finding, not changed here. Filed by the seat as objectui#10817.
- **Dormant producer.** `condToMongo` emits an empty map only for a comparison row whose value is `undefined` (H2), and the builder never holds that.
- **Dispatch pointer.** The dispatch cites `objectui#5240` for the ruling, but that number is an unrelated objectui card about `schema.userActions`. The ruling is objectstack#5240 (maintainer ruling of 2026-08-04: refuse), which is what `FilterConditionSchema`'s docblock cites. The `Clause-②` line above now cites objectstack#5240 by its repo (seat edit at landing, per the contract review).
